summary: iter35 [Share to Stories / Reels] verified end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest green — 4 new test_story_image_iter35 (story.png returns 200 with valid PNG signature + 1080x1920, second call cached/byte-identical, 404 on unknown share, byte-identical to reels_story.png inside social-kit.zip), 4 captions_iter34 regression + 5 social_kit_iter33 regression all pass. Frontend: (a) without canShare stub, data-testid='share-patch-story' is correctly absent from the DOM (feature-detection works); (b) with init-script stub installing navigator.canShare({files}) -> true and navigator.share capturing calls, the button renders with EN label 'Share to Stories / Reels' (not raw key); (c) clicking it produces exactly 1 window.__shareCalls entry containing files=[{name:'patch-and-pot-story.png', type:'image/png', size:110811}], text=AI-generated reels caption (e.g. 'Two plants. One Bristol patch...'), url='https://.../api/share/preview/<share_id>', title set; (d) Loader2 spinner + disabled state confirmed during in-flight fetch (verified in first run before cache warm-up); (e) Spanish locale (patchpot.lang.v1='es') shows translated label 'Compartir en Stories / Reels' — not raw key. Regression: share-patch-qr-download, share-patch-social-kit, share-patch-tweet all still present alongside.
critical_code_review_comments: share.py: new /story.png endpoint correctly delegates to share_social_kit.render_kit_images() (same render call that ZIP endpoint uses) so the standalone PNG and ZIP's reels_story.png are guaranteed byte-identical — verified by test_story_png_matches_kit_zip_reels_image.

Server-side caching is via shared_patch_story_png collection keyed on (share_id, version=updated_at) — same pattern as og.png + social-kit.zip + captions.json. Cache invalidation is automatic on snapshot edit. Lazy generation means no upfront cost for unshared snapshots.

Cache-Control 'public, max-age=86400' set server-side; the preview ingress overrides with no-store (acknowledged in spec). Tests correctly assert no client-side cache header — only server-side cache (second call returns identical bytes).

SharePatchModal.jsx canNativeShareFiles useMemo is correctly written with empty deps array — probes navigator.canShare({files:[1-byte File]}) once at mount. Try/catch ensures Safari quirks don't crash render. Button is wrapped in {canNativeShareFiles && ...} so it's literally NOT in the DOM when probe returns false — perfect feature-detection.

onShareStory() handler: parallel Promise.all for story.png + captions.json (no waterfall), passes File object (not raw Blob) so iOS share sheet picks correct app routing, gracefully swallows AbortError (user dismissed sheet) without surfacing as error. text=captions.reels_story, url=shareUrl (the /api/share/preview/<id> URL — right one for unfurling).

Share icon (lucide-react) added to existing import line — no new import statement. setSharingStory state flag is independent from main `state` reducer so the create/update loading state can't clobber it.

Minor nit: onShareStory uses console.warn on non-AbortError, no user-facing toast. Same posture as Tweet button (iter34). If story.png endpoint were hard-down the user gets no visual feedback. Acceptable for an optional share affordance.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required assertions met: feature-detection, stub flow with file+text+url+title verified, spinner/disabled UX, EN+ES locale labels, regression buttons all present)
